newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai rubber firmer on rising Tokyo, tight supply.
newsitem.headline: Thai rubber firmer on rising Tokyo, tight supply.

text.p: Thai rubber prices edged up slightly this week as heavy rains hampered rubber tapping, resulting in tighter supply, trade sources said on Friday.
The prices also took their cue from the Tokyo market which rose across the board on Friday.
Thai benchmark RSS3 for November shipment was quoted around 1.22-1.24 a kg FOB Bangkok against 1.19-1.23 last week. The same grade was quoted around 1.24-1.25 a kg FOB Bangkok for January shipment.
Latex price barely changed from last week and stood at 95 cents a kg FOB Bangkok.
"The rain could further support the prices. But I don't expect any sharp rise if the market lacks new fresh factors," one trader said.
The meteorological department warned of more heavy rain in the south, Thailand's major rubber tree growing region.
Auction market sources said only about 230,000 kg of rubber sheet had entered the market this week compared with 371,392 kg last week.
